source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of ethical issues (PDF 188-189).

items: Copyright ka ehtaram: kisi aur ka kaam ijazat ke baghair copy ya istemal na karein; research paper mein online articles ka text hawala diye baghair copy na karein.
Plagiarism se bachao: assignments mein istemal kiye gaye har iqtibas ya khayal ka maakhaz bata kar asal musannif ko credit dein.

blocks.prompt: Aap website ke paragraph ka khayal apne alfaaz mein report mein likhte hain. Kya phir bhi hawala dena zaroori hai?
blocks.explanation: Haan. Khayal us ke musannif ka hai, to alfaaz apne hon tab bhi credit dena zaroori hai.

items: Akhlaqi masail: copyright ka ehtaram aur hawala de kar plagiarism se bachao.
